name: Robert Marion
bio: A Representative from South Carolina; born 1766 in Berkeley District, S.C.; pursued an academic course, graduated from the University of the State of Pennsylvania (now the University of Pennsylvania) at Philadelphia in 1784; owned and managed plantation at Belle Isle, S.C.; justice of quorum, St. Stephen's Parish; justice of the peace, Charleston, S.C.; served in the South Carolina state house of representatives, 1790-1796, and in the South Carolina state senate, 1802-1805; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Ninth and to the two succeeding Congresses and served from March 4, 1805, until his resignation on December 4, 1810; died on his plantation in St. Stephen's Parish, March 22, 1811.
